task.title: Record the real-model error quality gate on L5b and L1
task.objective: At 4f81424a verify:ai-error-quality-live sends all 14 items of L5's labelled set through analyzeFailure on the real Qwen3.5-0.8B and passes 13/0 on two runs: baseline accuracy 7/8, AI accuracy 7/8, improvement 0, 1 false attribution (the AI kept the baseline's unrelated lead event on the case built with a wrong baseline), evidence links all shown whole, coalescing 500 to 1 and 2 to 2, no canary. The AI does not beat the baseline, so ROADMAP rule 7 keeps L5b's automatic analysis off. Append a note to awkit-djnl.8 and to awkit-djnl.1 giving the gate, the result and what stays open (the automatic analysis; for L1, an L4b explanation quality target and the owner's go/no-go). Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: both stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress, each with a note naming the gate commit and its live result, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, after the two `bd update --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` and the already-edited state documents: 9 outstanding / 294 closed with 135 edges, unchanged, and both narratives restating 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.

history.released_reason: error quality gate noted on awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1, nothing closed, no edge changed, export refreshed
